title: Onii-chan Dakedo Ai Sae Areba Kankeinai yo ne! Specials
justification: AniList 15881 has 6 episodes (2012-12-26 to 2013-05-29); an offline-database synonym is 'Picture Drama'. AniDB 9230 S2-S7 are 'Picture Drama 1..6' (Okome Da, Kuri Muku, Roudoku, Shiosai, Kutsushita, Nugitate) on 2012-12-26, 2013-01-30, 02-27, 03-27, 04-24, 05-29. The parent's offset -1 row sends them to TVDB 262092 0x01-0x06: 'Rice', 'Chestnut Shelling', 'Reading Aloud', 'Ocean Roar', 'Socks', 'Freshly Undressed', exactly the English meanings of the six Japanese titles, on the same dates. S1 (creditless opening) and S8 (ending version) are not episodes of the entry.
